name: Min-arc stop knuckle 4R: a preloaded one-sided knuckle in link 1 with J2 hard stops (plain spherical chain)

mechanism.notes: spherical 3R with link 1 split by a passive knuckle K. bodies: link 1a, link 1b, link 2, member 3 (hub-3 arm-end plate + K7 neck). joints: J1, K, J2, J3 O20 hubs on MR117-2RS pairs (revolutes). Open chain, GH closes it: loop mobility 4 vs the arm's 3 - the spare is set by the clock spring in K's cap (preload onto stop A) and the J2 interior-angle hard stops (min-arc law), so nothing sags (R17). sensed: K (encoder, the 4th coordinate is not a function of J1-J3 readings alone). custom: base, 3 links, member 3, 4 hub shafts, the clock spring strip (0.2 x 3 mm stainless, ~4 turns); catalogue: 4 x MR117-2RS pair + 2 O2 ISO 8734 stop dowels (K stop arc slot, J2 stop arc slot).

verdict: screened: variant B frozen exact 15.42 on Bench(110,360) (score 94.4, self-measured; conservative fold-margin reading 21.40, near-touch 21.37 at BA) - best self-measured frozen number so far, 0 passive translations, complexity 33; needs the independent verifier. Variant A (complexity 13.5) 22.17 fast converged.
limiter: B at BD, big bench: the fold (56 poses: stretched past stop B a1max 66, folded with J1 ~ J3), the knee window (16), contact (9); overhead reach 8/28; hub 3 (0.66) and link 2 (0.78) in band; near-touch 0.05 mm overhead. Red team: the forced sub-chain J1-K-J3 swings J1 20-40 deg/frame before stop B on the gallery loop (sub-chain margin 7.3) - dynamic stiffening risk for MuJoCo
note: Bench(60,160) fast unless stated. VARIANT B (docs/concepts/models/minarc-stop-knuckle-4r-pinknee.py: the pin-knee VModel + passive spring knuckle K in link 1 + J2 interior-angle stops): CMA (4 streams, 6234 tries) BD 6.19 fast -> FROZEN EXACT Bench(110,360) 15.42 (score 94.4; reach 0.769, follow 1.0, ib14 0.899, contact 0.023; near-touch 22.17, min metal 0.05 mm on the overhead raise clip); BA 7.27 -> 17.98 (near-touch 21.37, min metal 0.76 mm); BB (mstop 1, J2 dyad keeps 5 deg th-margin) 9.43 -> 21.40; at the pin knee's own seats knuckle locked 26.82 vs knuckle 24.00 frozen. Gate (B): 0.23 / 0.23 / 0.03 score pts -> converged. VARIANT A (docs/concepts/models/minarc-stop-knuckle-4r.py, kit, plain spherical chain + K, complexity 13.5): coarse 302 -> 49.10; CMA 6 streams 7886 tries -> 22.17 fast (gate 0.49 / 0.31 / 0.02 converged; 3R control at the same seats 45.91; near-touch 41.79); frozen exact pending (.cache/minarc/frozen_FA.json, FA3R; near-touch CMA AN1/AN2/AG -> .cache/minarc/cma_AN*.json). Judge's prediction 18-24 for the plain chain: refuted on the kit (22.17 fast); the knuckle is worth 23.7 points over its own 3R control only once seats are re-tuned for it. Spring: quasi-static gravity torque <= 0.008 N.m (B) / 0.018 (A) vs 0.08 N.m preload; MuJoCo pending L1 meshes.
